description: WI-1 measurement sets (ADR-SC-007). Task texts are copied from studio-runner/evaluation/grounding/corpus/tasks.jsonl; alpha steps from the 2026-10-26 alpha E2E suite.

steps: Go to "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)"
Copy the "Designed by" value from the infobox
Type the copied value in the "Search Wikipedia" field
Press Enter
Check that the page shows the heading "Guido van Rossum"
Check that the main heading contains the copied value
Go to "https://news.ycombinator.com/"
Click the "show" link
Check that the page title is "Show | Hacker News"
Copy the title of the first story
Click the comments link of the first story
Check that the story title on the page contains the copied title
Go to "https://docs.python.org/3/"
Copy the welcome text at the top of the page
Type the copied text in the "Quick search" field
Go to "https://github.com/microsoft/playwright"
Copy the repository description from the About section
Click the "Search or jump to" button
Type the copied description in the "Search or jump to" field
Press Enter
Check that the page shows the link "microsoft/playwright"
Choose "Exclude cross-listed papers"
Choose the "Grid" view
Choose the "List" view
Choose "Dark" under "Color"
Choose "Small" under "Text"
Choose "Descriptions" next to "Search on:"
Under "Date", choose "Announcement date"
Select "Author(s)" in the "Field to search" menu
Type "graph neural networks" in the "Search term..." box
Select "Title" in the "Field to search" menu
Click the "Search" button right under the search term box
Select GBP from Currency.
Select London from City.
Click the "Filter and sort" button
Click "Filter by Topic" to open it
Select "Money" in the "Topic" menu
Click the "Apply" button
Select "3.99" in the Python version menu at the top
Select "3.13" in the Python version menu at the top
Select "3.12" in the Python version menu at the bottom of the page
Select "Newest first" in the "Sort by" menu
Select "50 per page" in the "Results per page" menu
Select "Satellite" in the dropdown under the map
Select "Streets" in the map style menu
Select "50 items" in the dropdown above the list of results
Select "100 items" in the dropdown below the list of results
Select "testing" in the "Distribution:" menu under the "Search the contents of packages" heading
Select "64-bit ARM (AArch64)" in the "Architecture:" menu
Go to "https://docs.python.org/3/"
Select "3.13" in the "Python version" dropdown
Type "asyncio" in the "Quick search" field
Click the "Go" button
Check that the page shows the heading "Search Results"
Check that the page shows the link "asyncio — Asynchronous I/O"
Go to "https://shop.example.test/order"
Choose "Express" from the "Delivery speed" menu
Go to "https://shop.example.test/order"
Choose "Spanish" from the "Language" list
Tick the "Services" box under Type
Tick "Research and statistics" under Type
Tick the "Only show exact matches:" box
Copy the "Code Name" of Debian 13 from the "Index of releases" table
Type the copied code name in the small box left of the "Search" button at the top right of the page
Click the "Search" button at the top right of the page
Copy the text of the page heading "Document Search"
Type the copied text in the "Document name/title/RFC number" box
Click the "Search" button next to that box
